snippet.title: పుంగనూరు మన గుప్పిట్లోనే ఉండాలి | కార్యకర్తలను రెచ్చగొట్టిన పెద్దిరెడ్డి, మిథున్‌రెడ్డి! #Punganur
snippet.description:
The political tension in Punganur constituency of Annamayya district has reportedly escalated into violent incidents following a call allegedly made by former YSRCP minister Peddireddy Ramachandra Reddy and his son, Rajampet MP Peddireddy Mithun Reddy, urging party workers to retain control over the constituency regardless of whether the party is in power. Their message was reportedly that the constituency and its mandals must not slip out of their hands. Against this backdrop, YSRCP workers have been accused of attacking TDP candidates and supporters with stones and sticks as they were heading to file nominations for MPTC and ZPTC elections. Speaking at a YSRCP meeting in Chowdepalle, Peddireddy Ramachandra Reddy reportedly said that his family had maintained political dominance in Punganur since he entered politics and that the constituency must remain under their control. He assured party workers that they should file their nominations without fearing TDP and said he would take responsibility for ensuring their victory. Rajampet MP Mithun Reddy also reportedly urged YSRCP workers not to be afraid of TDP, claiming that false cases would not stop them. Both leaders allegedly encouraged party workers with the message, “Your responsibility is to file the nominations; ours is to ensure victory.” Following these speeches, the nomination process reportedly turned violent in several mandals across the constituency. In Punganur, YSRCP workers allegedly pelted TDP supporters with stones. At Nadigadda in Sadum mandal, a car belonging to Pawan Kumar Reddy was reportedly set on fire, while Shiv Anand was allegedly attacked near a nomination centre. YSRCP leaders Komiri Ramana, Kapadimitlapalle Venkataramana and associates of Kanchi have also been accused of attacking TDP workers with sticks, stones and bottles while allegedly under the influence of alcohol, leaving several people seriously injured. In connection with the disturbances during Punganur municipal nominations, police reportedly named MP Mithun Reddy as Accused No. 1 (A1) in three cases. Cases have reportedly been registered against a total of 160 people. Meanwhile, at Thummarakunta in Peddathippasamudram mandal, a confrontation reportedly broke out after TDP candidates Manjula and Savithramma filed their nominations, involving supporters of a YSRCP worker named Roopa. YSRCP supporters alleged that TDP workers had torn up their nomination papers. However, TDP supporters alleged that YSRCP workers subsequently attacked Savithramma's house at night. Sub-Inspector Paramesh Naik has reportedly initiated an investigation into the incident. In another development, police have allegedly registered what TDP leaders describe as a false case against Srinivasulu Naidu, chairman of the Somala Market Committee, who filed his nomination as an MPTC candidate from Irikipenta. Local residents have expressed concern that the disturbing conditions witnessed during the 2021 elections could be repeated. Critics accuse YSRCP workers of undermining democracy through alleged intimidation of candidates, misuse of SC/ST cases and coercion involving cases related to Karnataka liquor. They have also criticised what they describe as a pattern of engaging in violence while simultaneously portraying the party as a victim, as well as the alleged inaction of the police. TDP leaders have further accused the police and officials of being biased in favour of Peddireddy Ramachandra Reddy and Mithun Reddy. These allegations remain subject to investigation and should be distinguished from findings established by the authorities or a court.

snippet.title: 🧿छोटी सी बात! नीचे लिखा हुआ पढ़िए ज़रूर 👇🏽
snippet.description:
🧿कभी काम पर जाने की जल्दी, कभी तबीयत की नासाजी, कभी नीयत की ख़राबी। ये कुछ वजह हैं जब हम हड़बड़ी में दाल बनाते हैं। और भूल जाते हैं कि दाल बनाने का सही प्रोटोकॉल क्या होता है। नतीजा बदहज़मी, अफ़ारा, जोड़ों में दर्द, प्रोटीन की कमी, विटामिन की कमी आदि समस्याओं का सामना करना पड़ता है। 
अगर इन छोटी छोटी बातों पर गौर करें तो पुरुषों को समझना चाहिए कि उनकी पत्नियाँ घर का काम कैसे करती हैं। बारीकिययाँ जो हर छोटे बड़े काम में होती हैं वो उनको नज़र नहीं आता।तभी वो कटाक्ष मारते हैं कि पूरा दिन क्या किया। पूरा दिन हमने अपने परिवार वाले लोगों के लिए पौष्टिक भोजन बनाने में, घर सँवारने में, सबकी जरूरतों का ख़याल रखते हुए बिताया। पुरुषों को हमेशा अपनी स्त्री का सम्मान करना चाहिए। यदि वो बाहर से कमा कर लाता है। तो स्त्रियां घर के काम को करके उनकी सेहत और धन, दोनों का ख़याल रखती हैं। 
So be grateful to your better halves, for everything they do for their families. ♥️…✍🏼
